{{Top|leg}}
A '''message wafer''' was a flat, rectangular card that, when received by the intended individual, was folded down the middle and broken open along the seam. The card was then folded and placed standing on a flat surface for video and audio output. After having played the sender's message, the wafer disintegrated.
